Gramlot 0.2.9 removes the JavaScript routes package added in 0.2.8.

## What changes

- `@gramlot/gramlot/routes` and `js/src/routes/` are removed. No consumer remained: the Node and Bun adapters follow the non-Kajenn Python adapters, which do not use routes, and the functions of the browser handlers are called directly. The package lives on, unpublished, in `genro-org/genro-routes-js`.
- GC-225 records that a handler of `Gramlot` is not a `RoutingClass`.

## Upgrading from 0.2.8

- Code importing `@gramlot/gramlot/routes` must stop doing so; nothing in the Gramlot repositories imported it.
